name: Brawlforge
short: Fight 40 fighters in fast SNES-style arcade brawls. Combos, specials, 5 arenas.
full:
Brawlforge is a fast 2D arcade fighting game inspired by the classic SNES-era brawlers.

Pick from 40 original fighters - humans, beasts, undead, elementals and robots - and fight across 5 atmospheric arenas. Light and heavy punches, kicks, uppercuts, sweeps, blocks and a special move for every fighter. Land a hit and cancel it into your special for big combos.

MODES
- Arcade: pick a fighter and climb a ladder of 10, 20 or all 39 opponents. Lose and you can continue or watch a short ad to keep your score.
- Exhibition: choose any two fighters, rounds, time limit and arena and fight it out.
- Characters: read every fighter's bio and stats and watch a live demo of all their moves.
- High scores and a profile with your career stats.

FEATURES
- 40 unique fighters with their own looks, moves and specials
- 5 parallax arenas
- Touch controls built for phones (virtual stick and buttons) plus gamepad support
- CPU opponents with adjustable difficulty, game speed and screen shake options
- Everything is drawn in code and the music is synthesised, so the download stays small
- Works offline

Free to play with optional ads. Made by Arcadoff.
